description_en: Queries instant virus scan tasks under the current Alibaba Cloud account by paging
description_zh: 分页查询当前阿里云账号下的即时病毒扫描任务
name: ListVirusScanTasks

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in paging. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in paging. Valid values: 1 to 1000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~1000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The collection of scan path scopes. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 扫描的路径范围集合，不允许重复
parameters.name: scan_modes

parameters.help_en: The collection of scan performance modes. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 扫描性能模式集合，不允许重复
parameters.name: performance_modes

parameters.help_en: The collection of virus scan task IDs. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 病毒扫描任务ID集合，不允许重复
parameters.name: task_ids

parameters.help_en:
The user group ID, used to filter tasks whose effective scope includes the specified user group. You can obtain the value from:
[ListUserGroups](~~ListUserGroups~~): Lists user groups
parameters.help_zh:
用户组ID，用于筛选生效范围包含该用户组的任务。取值来源：
[ListUserGroups](~~ListUserGroups~~)：批量查询用户组
parameters.name: user_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The task status. Valid values:
0: Not canceled. This is the default value.
1: Canceled.
-1: No status filter. All tasks are returned
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态。取值：
0：未取消，默认值。
1：已取消。
-1：不按状态过滤，返回全部任务
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The end point for filtering by task expiration time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The value must be greater than StartTime
parameters.help_zh: 任务失效时间的筛选终点，秒级Unix时间戳。必须大于StartTime
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The start point for filtering by task expiration time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. This parameter must be specified together with EndTime. Specifying this parameter alone does not take effect
parameters.help_zh: 任务失效时间的筛选起点，秒级Unix时间戳。必须与EndTime一同传入，单独传入不生效
parameters.name: start_time
